cases.name: Cecilia "Cecy" Rios
cases.about: She was a student at Richmond High School. Cecy liked poetry and wanted to become a lawyer.
cases.narrative: While taking a shortcut through San Pablo’s Downer Elementary School on her way home, she was sexually assaulted, and stabbed 18 times. Authorities said he returned to Downer Elementary School and placed a red bandanna -- the symbol of a local street gang -- over her body in an attempt to mislead authorities into thinking the killing was gang-related.She was murdered on 3/14/1994. Her mother found her (body) 3/15/1994.
